components.name: Header and language navigation
components.description: Plain navigation with an underlined current destination and paired language routes.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-header-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:32px;color:var(--ink,#20201F);font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','PingFang HK','Noto Sans CJK TC',sans-serif;line-height:1.75}.ds-top-nav{display:flex;gap:24px;margin-left:auto}.ds-languages{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;white-space:nowrap}.ds-header-nav a{display:inline-flex;min-height:44px;align-items:center;font-size:.875rem;color:inherit;text-decoration:none;text-underline-offset:4px;text-decoration-thickness:1px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-header-nav [aria-current]{text-decoration:underline;font-weight:600}.ds-header-nav a:hover{color:var(--accent,#895B05)}.ds-header-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ink,#20201F);outline-offset:5px;border-radius:3px}.ds-languages>span{font-size:.75rem;color:var(--muted,#686762)}@media(max-width:860px){.ds-header-nav{gap:20px}.ds-top-nav{gap:16px}}@media(max-width:620px){.ds-header-nav{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:2px 18px}.ds-languages{margin-left:auto;gap:8px}.ds-languages a{font-size:.8rem}.ds-top-nav{order:3;width:100%;margin-left:0;gap:24px}}

components.name: Home resource row

components.html:

components.css: .ds-resource{display:block;position:relative;padding:28px 30px 28px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#E8E6E1);color:var(--ink,#20201F);text-decoration:none;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','PingFang HK','Noto Sans CJK TC',sans-serif;line-height:1.75;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-resource-arrow{position:absolute;right:0;top:27px;font-size:1.35rem}.ds-resource h2{margin:0;font-size:1.35rem;line-height:1.5;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.015em}.ds-resource p{color:var(--muted,#686762);font-size:.95rem;margin:10px 0 0}.ds-resource-cue{display:inline-block;margin-top:16px;font-size:.875rem;font-weight:500;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px;text-decoration-thickness:1px}.ds-resource:hover{color:var(--accent,#895B05)}.ds-resource:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ink,#20201F);outline-offset:5px;border-radius:3px}@media(max-width:620px){.ds-resource{padding-top:24px;padding-bottom:24px}}

components.css: .ds-toc{position:sticky;top:28px;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','PingFang HK','Noto Sans CJK TC',sans-serif;font-size:.82rem;line-height:1.75;color:var(--muted,#686762)}.ds-toc h2{font-size:.8rem;line-height:1.5;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.03em;color:var(--ink,#20201F);margin:0 0 12px}.ds-toc ol{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}.ds-toc li+li{margin-top:4px}.ds-toc a{display:block;min-height:44px;padding:7px 0;color:inherit;text-decoration:none;text-underline-offset:4px;text-decoration-thickness:1px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-toc a:hover{color:var(--accent,#895B05);text-decoration:underline}.ds-toc a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ink,#20201F);outline-offset:5px;border-radius:3px}@media(max-width:860px){.ds-toc{position:static;padding-bottom:16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#E8E6E1)}.ds-toc ol{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:2px 20px}.ds-toc li+li{margin-top:0}}@media(max-width:620px){.ds-toc ol{gap:2px 16px}.ds-toc a{font-size:.8rem;line-height:1.6}}

components.name: Support contact panel
components.description: A flat white contact surface with an email action and a visible address.
components.html:
Contact support

Tell us the app version, iOS version and what happened. Redact customer and payment information first.

Email support ↗lenny996@163.com
components.css: .ds-contact{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:14px 28px;align-items:center;background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--ink,#20201F);border:1px solid var(--line,#E8E6E1);border-radius:14px;padding:24px 28px;margin-bottom:44px;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','PingFang HK','Noto Sans CJK TC',sans-serif;line-height:1.75}.ds-contact h2{margin:0;font-size:1.22rem;line-height:1.5;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.015em;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-contact p{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--muted,#686762);margin:6px 0 0;max-width:650px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-contact a{color:inherit;text-underline-offset:4px;text-decoration-thickness:1px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-contact .ds-contact-action{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:16px;min-height:48px;background:var(--ink,#20201F);color:var(--surface,#fff);text-decoration:none;padding:10px 20px;border-radius:10px;font-size:.95rem;font-weight:500;max-width:100%;text-align:center}.ds-contact .ds-contact-action:hover{color:var(--surface,#fff);background:#3A3935}.ds-contact-address{grid-column:1/-1;font-size:.875rem;justify-self:start;min-height:44px;padding-top:6px}.ds-contact-address:hover{color:var(--accent,#895B05)}.ds-contact a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ink,#20201F);outline-offset:5px;border-radius:3px}@media(max-width:620px){.ds-contact{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:20px;gap:12px;margin-bottom:28px}.ds-contact h2{font-size:1.1rem}.ds-contact-action{justify-self:start}.ds-contact-address{font-size:.85rem}}

narrative.overview:
A quiet Read surface: compact editorial introductions lead into practical support and long-form privacy text. Warm paper, dark type, white contact panels and fine rules carry the hierarchy. The official App icon provides the established identity.

This contract describes the built `public/` site only: six Traditional Chinese and English routes, plus a shared bilingual 404. It does not define the App interface. Product facts and policy wording remain in `AUDIT.md` and the page sources.
keyCharacteristics: System typography with generous paragraph leading.
Flat surfaces, light dividers and restrained link accents.
Paired language routes with the same component structure.
Plain HTML, CSS and a local icon; ordinary links support reading and contact.
dos: Do preserve the warm canvas, charcoal text, white panels and light borders.
Do retain the inherited system font stack and the official App icon unchanged.
Do maintain equivalent bilingual navigation and readable, wrapping text.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, generous link targets and the mobile topic grid.
donts: Don't turn the ruled reading layout into a collection of elevated cards.
Don't introduce remote fonts, scripts, forms or analytics into this static site.
Don't hide policy or support sections behind interactive disclosure controls.
Don't extend this site-specific contract to the App or replace product facts with design guidance.
